note_ko: 장소 디테일 기준(docs/장소팩_작성기준.md)에 따라 작성. 한결 외출복 사진(1004)을 바탕으로 한 장소. {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}/{P}=her/Her, {o}=her, {lit}=빛이 닿는 의상 부분.
setting_en: a quiet botanical garden courtyard in autumn
feature_en: a red maple tree and a yellow-leaved tree beside the stone path
low green shrubs and ornamental grasses along both edges of the path
ground_en: a path of flat gray stones with moss in the gaps
brown fallen leaves scattered over the stones and the soil
far_en: the stone path curving away between tall trees
a trimmed green hedge and a stone lantern far in the garden

오후.sky_en: a soft blue sky seen through the red and yellow leaves
오후.light_en: warm soft sunlight comes from the camera's left, falling across {p} face and shoulders
오후.shadow_en: soft shadows of the branches lie across the stones toward the camera's right
오후.desc_ko: 늦가을 오후, 따뜻한 햇빛이 카메라 왼쪽에서 비춤

해질녘.sky_en: a pale orange sky behind the tree crowns
해질녘.light_en: low amber sunlight comes from the camera's left, lighting {p} face and shoulders
해질녘.shadow_en: long soft shadows stretch across the stone path toward the camera's right
해질녘.desc_ko: 해 지기 직전, 낮은 호박빛 해가 카메라 왼쪽에서 비춤

천천히 걷기.pose_en: walks slowly along the stone path toward the camera in a relaxed three-quarter stride
천천히 걷기.moment_en: {s} smiles gently and glances toward the camera

3/4 서기.pose_en: stands on the stone path with {p} body angled toward the left side of the frame and one hand holding a shoulder-bag strap near {p} chest
3/4 서기.moment_en: {s} turns {p} head toward the camera with a warm smile
3/4 서기.desc_ko: 몸은 왼쪽으로 3/4, 고개는 카메라 쪽, 한 손은 가방끈

단풍 보며 서기.pose_en: stands on the stone path with {p} weight on one leg
단풍 보며 서기.moment_en: {s} looks toward the camera and smiles a little
단풍 보며 서기.desc_ko: 한쪽 다리에 체중을 싣고 서서 카메라를 봄

camera.전신: Full-length shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from above {p} head to below {p} feet, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the garden softly out of focus
camera.무릎 위: Medium-long shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to just above the knees, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the garden softly out of focus
camera.허리 위: Medium shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to {p} waist, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the garden softly out of focus

ground_contact_en: {P} feet rest on the flat gray stones among a few fallen leaves
style_en: natural lifestyle photography with fine film grain and realistic skin texture

the stones are flat and gray with green moss between them
the shrubs are dark green with a few brown leaves on the ground around them
